context: Manages loading and unloading of MapTile objects based on camera position and zoom level.
description: Maintains a set of currently loaded tiles and ensures the right data is generated and kept in memory for smooth gameplay.

classes.name: ATileStreamer
classes.description: Actor responsible for streaming map tiles in and out of the world.

methods.name: ComputeWantedTilesFromCamera()
methods.description: Determine which tiles should be loaded based on camera location, frustum and zoom.
methods.pseudocode: Use a quadtree to find tile keys intersecting the camera frustum at the current LOD.

methods.name: StreamInOut(wantedSet)
methods.description: Load missing tiles and unload tiles no longer needed.
methods.pseudocode: For each key in wantedSet not in loaded: call UWorldGenerator.GenTile(key) and add to loaded; for each loaded tile not in wantedSet: remove and free resources.

pseudocode: Each frame, determine the set of tiles intersecting the camera view.
Generate and load any missing tiles asynchronously.
Unload tiles that are outside of the view to save memory.
